name: lotsofsounds
description: Find and add CC0 sound effects, UI sounds, game audio and ambience to a project. No credit needed.

api_key.title: Lots of Sounds API key
api_key.description: Optional. A Pro API key (starts with los_) lets the MCP tools search the full catalog. Free samples work with no key. Get one with `npx lotsofsounds login` or at https://lotsofsounds.com/dashboard/api-keys.
